facts.fact: FB Attorneys reports that the Personal Data Protection Commission, established under the Personal Data Protection Act, Cap. 44, delivered a ruling in Complaint No. PDPC/CMP/002/2025, so the body was acting.

FB Attorneys reports the Commission's ruling of 19 August 2025 in Complaint No. PDPC/CMP/002/2025 against an Instagram business-page respondent (not named in the article): TZS 20 million damages to the complainant, a TZS 5 million fine payable to the Commission, and deletion of a newborn's photos within 14 days.
